integrity: An analytical finite- and infinite-length proof with a standalone exact-rational cross-check is provided. The related 2011 general Markov-binomial distribution and modal-shape results are explicitly credited. The 1981 full-text access limitation is disclosed. No independent audit or independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only two-state symmetric persistent chains with \(1/2<p<1\); even lengths \(N\ge4\).
Adjacent central-bin comparison, not classification of all global modes.
Asymptotics at fixed p; no uniform-in-p convergence rate.
Full text of relevant 1981 predecessor unavailable; priority not independently certified.
title: Sharp initial-bias phase boundary for central bins of persistent Markov walks
